purpose: Phase-selective context injection index for pcore-orchestra. Maps each six-file context file to its purpose, estimated size, per-phase section relevance, and a fullReadOnlyWhenExplicitlyNeeded flag. Used by context-detector.js buildContextInjection() to emit only phase-relevant summaries + file pointers (never full file contents) so context stays well under per-phase token budgets.

files.label: product definition, goals, features, scope
files.notes: Read first for product grounding; small enough to include fully in plan/implement.

files.label: system structure, boundaries, invariants
files.notes: Large (~11k tokens) — only emit section summaries + file pointers unless explicitly needed. Never fully inject.

files.label: implementation rules and conventions
files.notes: Conventions implementer must follow; verifier checks suites.

files.label: theme, colors, typography, components
files.notes: Small; only relevant when UI/Studio docs are touched.

files.label: workflow, scoping, verification
files.notes: Scoping + workflow rules; verifier runs the listed checks.

files.label: current phase, completed work, next steps
files.notes: Very large (~48k tokens) — never fully injected. Emit only the Current Phase section pointer; read fully only when explicitly needed.
